root_cause.text: The `lpc18xx_dmamux_reserve` function fails to release the device reference obtained from `of_find_device_by_node()` on both success and error paths, causing a device reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `put_device(&pdev->dev)` on every exit path (both normal return and all error goto labels), as shown in the diff where `err_put_pdev` is introduced and called from all early error conditions, and a `put_device` is added before the final success return. The commit message explicitly states "Make sure to drop the reference taken when looking up the DMA mux platform device during route allocation."

intent_record.intent_summary: Add common error handling to release platform device reference and prevent a reference leak in lpc18xx_dmamux_reserve.
intent_record.what: Replaced direct return ERR_PTR(-EINVAL) statements with goto err_put_pdev in multiple error paths, and added a local variable ret initialized to -EINVAL.
intent_record.how: When an error condition occurs, instead of returning immediately, the code jumps to a common label (presumably err_put_pdev) that performs cleanup (likely platform_device_put(pdev)) before returning ERR_PTR(ret). This ensures that the platform device reference is properly released on error paths.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix resource leak in lpc18xx_dmamux_reserve by properly cleaning up platform device reference on busy DMA request error.
intent_record.what: Replaced direct return of ERR_PTR(-EBUSY) with setting ret = -EBUSY and jumping to err_put_pdev label.
intent_record.how: Ensures that when a DMA request is busy, the function performs cleanup of the platform device reference via the err_put_pdev label before returning an error, preventing a reference leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing put_device calls to avoid device reference leak in lpc18xx_dmamux_reserve.
intent_record.what: Added put_device(&pdev->dev) call before successful return and added an error label err_put_pdev with put_device and ERR_PTR return.
intent_record.how: Ensures that the device reference obtained earlier is released both on success and on error, preventing reference leaks.

commit e5f4ae84be7421010780984bdc121eac15997327
Author: Joachim Eastwood <manabian@gmail.com>
Date:   Sat Jul 11 14:12:06 2015 +0200

    dmaengine: add driver for lpc18xx dmamux
    
    Add support for DMA on NXP LPC18xx/43xx platforms which has
    a multiplexer in front of the PL080 dma request lines.
    
    The mux is a single register in the LPC18xx/43xx CREG block
    and can multiplex up to 4 request lines to each of the 16
    lines on the PL080.
    
    Signed-off-by: Joachim Eastwo
bic_trace_step.reason: The lpc18xx_dmamux_reserve function calls of_find_device_by_node() at line 67 but never releases the obtained device reference via put_device(). This leaks the reference on both success and all error paths. No put_device() call is present in the function body.
